I scored AIR 4843 in NEET 2025. It was my very first attempt and I can confidently say that Chemisphere played a huge role in making that possible. Chemistry was my strongest subject in the exam, and that’s only because of how well it was taught here. My organic and physical chemistry was very strong, and I didn't have a single negative in these two topics in NEET. Chandan sir doesn’t just teach formulas — he teaches logic, connections, and how to think like a top scorer. The notes were crisp, the classes were focused, and every single doubt was taken seriously. I never felt lost or overlooked.
The way Chemistry was simplified and made interesting gave me a lot of confidence. If you're a NEET aspirant and Chemistry is bothering you — just join Chemisphere and stop overthinking it.

That’s the stuff we live for. You earned it with your hard work, and we’re just glad we could be a part of the journey. Wishing you even bigger milestones ahead. Keep making us proud! 🔥

Would definitely recommend to all aspirants!

Thank you for such a thoughtful review! 🌟
Organic Chemistry often feels like a puzzle—until someone gives you the right lens to look through. I’m glad we could make it click for you.

At Chemisphere, we don’t believe in “one size fits all.” Every student deserves guidance that speaks directly to their learning style. That’s why our mix of personal attention, group sessions, and precise notes isn’t just about teaching—it’s about creating breakthroughs.

To any JEE aspirant reading this: If Organic has ever felt confusing, random, or memory-based, you’ve just been approaching it wrong. With the right mentorship, it becomes one of the most scoring and enjoyable parts of Chemistry. Let’s change how you see the subject—and your results will follow.

To be able to handle all 3 of these alone is a very hard task, but this is where Chemisphere came into play. Sir had taught me the from the basics to the advanced level in a very smooth and linear way addressing all my doubts and queries along the way. Sir not only helped me in my academis he also helped me in the day to day troubles of life. He is a very supporting character and very strong mentor. I still remember going through only the notes of al three parts even on the last night before the exam and feeling very confident about my chemistry. I want to thank Chandan Sir for all he has done for me. Thank you.

To those still unsure—stop surviving in the system. Come thrive with us.

featured_reviews.name: swapna khade
featured_reviews.review_text: The experience of enrolling my son with Chemisphere was very good and the most correct decision. The content and the flow of topics in lectures were crisp and covered the syllabus at conceptual level and from exam point of view as well.  Learning chemistry with Chandan Sir has helped my son immensely to clear not only JEE Main, JEE Advanced with flying colors but all other exams also like BITSAT, MHCET, IISER Aptitude Test etc .
